scheme_name: Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme for Stipend to Scheduled Caste Lawyers
other_conditions: Applicant must be a law graduate
Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste category
Application must be made within two years of registration in Gujarat Bar Council
Benefit is available to one person only once
Senior lawyer must have been practicing for at least 10 years
Senior lawyer can retain up to two junior lawyers for training
Training should be given at the district headquarters (or taluka headquarters as per amendment)
Trainee junior advocates must submit a certificate of training to the senior lawyer every month
At least 15% of applicants must be from the most marginalized of the scheduled castes
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend for up to three years for law graduates (₹1,000 per month in the first year, ₹800 in the second, and ₹600 in the third) and ₹500 per month for senior lawyers providing training.
